# The Menstrual Cycle

# Menstruation, Ovulation, and How Pregnancy Occurs

## The menstrual cycle is the monthly process of changes that occur to prepare the body for possible pregnancy. A menstrual

cycle is defined as the first day of menstrual bleeding of one cycle to the first day of menstrual bleeding of the next cycle.

The average menstrual cycle lasts about 28 days.

# DAY 1

![](data:image/png;base64,)

### Ovary

# DAY 5

Estrogen levels start to increase. Estrogen causes the endometrium (the lining of the uterus) to grow and thicken.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

### Endometrium Egg

# DAY 14

## An egg is released from the ovary and moves into one of the two fallopian tubes (ovulation). After ovulation, progesterone

levels begin to increase, while estrogen levels decrease.
